sentences.text: No; at the time of reset, the lender may, at its option, provide EMI-based personal loan borrowers a choice to switch over to a fixed rate as per its Board-approved policy, so the option is permitted but not mandatory.
The RBI directions also require any applicable switching charges and incidental service charges or administrative costs to be transparently disclosed in the sanction letter and again when revised.
The earlier bank policy likewise says the bank may, at its option, offer a choice to switch to a fixed rate at reset.
